title: EvaluatePackage - Actor
content:
Member of: Actor Script

Forces this actor's AI to re-evaluate its package stack.

Syntax:
Function EvaluatePackage(bool abResetAI=false) native

Parameters:
- abResetAI: If true, it will reset the actors AI not just evaluate package
    Default: False

Return Value:
None.

Examples:
; Tell Bob to re-evaluate his package stack
Bob.EvaluatePackage()

See Also:
- Actor Script
- GetCurrentPackage - Actor
